)


def parse_args():

    p.add_argument("--tau_rank", type=float, default=0.5)
    p.add_argument("--tau_knn", type=float, default=0.6)
    p.add_argument("--self_iterate", action="store_true",
                   help="Student becomes generator each generation (classic model collapse setup)")
    p.add_argument("--no_quality_filter", action="store_true",
                   help="Disable quality filter in diversity selection (for self-iterate experiments)")
    return p.parse_args()


def run_generation(generator_model, tokenizer, train_chunks, gen_dir, args, device):
    from generate import build_prompts, generate_batch
    num_prompts = (args.gen_tokens // args.gen_max_new_tokens) + 1
